summary: Architectural blueprint and implementation plan for Ishizaki, a private single-user academic operating system. Outlines the 4-view debloated UI, local-first IndexedDB and Firebase sync engine, Backblaze B2 vault proxy, 3-tier AI routing cascade (Groq -> OpenRouter -> Gemini), login-driven adaptive timetable, rapid-revision Exam Mode, and verifiable system diagnostics.
